title: Manufacturing Substrate Regime Model
description: The Manufacturing Substrate Regime Model (MSRM) is a structural framework for organizing and calibrating complex manufacturing systems through explicitly declared operating regimes, boundary semantics, and operator-mediated interactions. MSRM is descriptive, non-physical, and non-optimizing, intended to support clarity and interpretability in extreme manufacturing environments without altering existing processes or tooling.
notes: This record establishes MSRM as a stable, archival reference framework. Future revisions, if any, will preserve structural intent and descriptive scope.
